Select approved drugs at phase 4 that have early-stage indications recorded at phase 1. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter where molecule_dictionary.max_phase equals 4 and drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind equals 1. Return chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
